title: Mobile Xray services
agency_path: JUSTICE, DEPARTMENT OF.FEDERAL PRISON SYSTEM / BUREAU OF PRISONS.FAO
detail_text: The Federal Bureau of Prisons (BOP), Bastrop, Texas intends to make an award of an indefinite delivery/requirements type contract/Blanket Purchase Agreement with firm fixed prices to a responsible entity for the provision of Mobile x-ray services. The Mobile X-ray company will provide services for the inmates incarcerated at the Federal Correctional Institution (FCI), located in Bastrop, Texas This is a Sources Sought only, for gathering informaiton.
